nightly.description: Automated builds from the main branch

notes: update.veil.invalid is a placeholder until the update domain and its onion service exist.
Update checks always go over Tor.

MAR files are signed for Mozilla's updater with each channel's NSS certificate; release manifests are signed separately with the Ed25519 manifest key so anyone can check published hashes before rollout.
rollout_hold_hours is the minimum time between publishing a release manifest and serving the update, so independent builders can compare hashes first.
